threshold_source: saved checkpoint internal July31 validation; never tuned on external data
metric: maximum-cardinality one-to-one marker-center match within8 exported-image pixels
crop_policy: one deterministic native-resolution crop per reviewed image; annotation-centered with path-hash jitter, identical to training crop_sample; no resize
interpretation: July22 is a separate-date single recording excluded from the new July31 DINO training manifest.
Annotations select deterministic crops; this evaluates marker centers in those crops, not full-frame background false positives.
July22 images are exported at1920px width while the July31 training images are3840px wide; native640px crops therefore have a scale/domain shift.
Eight-pixel matching is in the exported July22 image; it is approximately16 pixels of the original3840px source.
The frozen backbone was pretrained externally; this result concerns the newly trained marker head and this small labeled dataset.
Marker-center precision/recall/F1 are not bounding-box mAP or3D reconstruction accuracy.
The existing YOLO model may have prior data exposure; use this as a descriptive same-crop comparison, not proof of equal training conditions.
